summary: Levi Strauss & Co. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a cybersecurity incident. An unauthorized third party gained access to three employee computers via social engineering, accessed and exfiltrated certain corporate information. The company contained and terminated the access, states no consumer data was impacted, and no business interruption occurred. Management believes the incident will not have a material impact on business strategy, operations, financial condition, or results. This is a routine operational disclosure, not a special situation, so no deal terms, advisors, or strategic actions apply. What to watch: regulatory notifications and any subsequent materiality assessments.
